text:
Lena: Quick shoutout to everyone who helped with the coffee cart swap this morning — the new grinder is a game changer ☕️ :tada:
Mateo: omg the cold brew station is immaculate. big win for mornings :heart_eyes:
Priya: huge thanks to @Sam Ops for lugging the crates up from storage — saved me a meltdown on the way in :raised_hands:
Jess: and @Nora jumped in to fix the dodgy outlet in the pantry so we could actually plug the grinder in 🔌 :sparkles:
Ari: also appreciate the improv signage — the sticky notes made it entertaining while we figured a permanent label :laughing:
Sam Ops: happy to help! shoutout to the night crew who boxed up the old gear neatly. team handoff was smooth.
Nora: no prob, happy it was just a loose wire. send pics of any future setup ideas and I can do a safety check quick.
Priya: personal thanks to @Jess for bringing extra oat milk — made someone's morning (me) :relaxed:
Lena: can we give a micro-kudos on the weekly board for Sam + Nora + Jess? tiny reward? :coin:
Mateo: yes pls — I'll add them. adding short notes so people see the ❤️
Jess: also small FYI — analytics team helped unblock a dashboard last night so the demo went well. big props to Priya for late-night sleuthing. :clap:
Priya: ahhh that was a team effort. shoutout to Mateo for spotting the bad filter too.
Ari: this is exactly the kind of cross-team heroics i love seeing. makes the office feel like a well-oiled snack machine :joy:
reminder-bot: :wave: 3 people have been mentioned for kudos in this thread. Don't forget to claim your micro-reward from the hobby-stash in the break room!
Lena: perfect, thanks bot. wrapping up — thanks y'all, felt good to see people step in. means a lot. :sparkling_heart:
Mateo: same — thanks everyone. low-key excited for next week's bagel run planning committee 😅
Jess: volunteer signups imminent :muscle:
Nora: night crew and SRE also sending virtual high-fives :handshake:
